basic_profile.bio: I'm a new eBay seller trying to navigate the intricacies of online marketplaces. Originally from Austin, Texas, I juggle my side hustle with a full-time job in digital marketing. I love exploring new tech trends, but I dislike complex return policies. My online activity usually peaks in the evenings after work, and I'm happily single with a penchant for adventure games.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a foundational understanding of e-commerce from my digital marketing career and am learning about online selling through trial and error. I regularly read articles and watch tutorials to enhance my knowledge.
